duration: 5 weeks, Monday to Friday (2026: June 22 to July 24 and July 28 to Aug 28)
pay_detail: Stipend of $96 a day (up to $480 a week) plus $20 weekly dependability bonus and $20 weekly safety bonus. $200 tuition, with tuition help based on need.
name: Youth Urban and Community Forestry Crew (Tacoma)
what_you_do: Join a crew of 8 teens and 2 adult leaders on tree and park projects in city parks, public lands and community gardens. About 32 hours a week of work plus 8 hours of training.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 15 to 18 who can travel to the central meeting place each day. Housing is not provided.
deadline_text: 2026 Washington sessions ran June 22 to July 24 and July 28 to Aug 28 (dates subject to change). 2027 dates and deadline not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Tacoma apply link on the program page. Ask about tuition help.
notes: Crews may earn high school credit if your school agrees. The same program also runs in Eugene, OR and Boise, ID.
